cases.stdout:
usage: lookbook [-h] {curate,list-plugins,list-recipes,serve,mcp} ...

positional arguments:
  {curate,list-plugins,list-recipes,serve,mcp}
    curate              Curate `source` into K reference images. Recipes (see `lookbook list-
                        recipes`): - `random`: placeholder (Phase 0). - `funnel`,
                        `funnel_relaxed`: Phase 1 cheap funnel, no GPU. - `diverse`,
                        `diverse_clip`: Phase 2 — funnel + embeddings + facility- location
                        selection. Downloads model weights on first use. - `diverse_mock`: same
                        shape as `diverse`, no-download (tests / sanity). Prints a JSON record of
                        the run to stdout. The manifest persists to the user's app data folder
                        unless `--in-memory` is passed.
    list-plugins        List all registered scorers / selectors / filters / embedders.
    list-recipes        List built-in curation recipes and YAML profiles.
    serve               Start the lookbook HTTP server. Routes are uniform `POST /<verb>` with
                        JSON bodies. See `/docs` for the auto-generated Swagger UI. Override the
                        data root with `LOOKBOOK_DATA_ROOT=...` before starting.
    mcp                 Start the lookbook MCP server. Default stdio transport is what Claude
                        Desktop and the Anthropic SDK spawn an MCP server with. Override the data
                        root with `LOOKBOOK_DATA_ROOT=...` before starting.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Curate `source` into K reference images.

Recipes (see `lookbook list-recipes`):
  - `random`: placeholder (Phase 0).
  - `funnel`, `funnel_relaxed`: Phase 1 cheap funnel, no GPU.
  - `diverse`, `diverse_clip`: Phase 2 — funnel + embeddings + facility-
    location selection. Downloads model weights on first use.
  - `diverse_mock`: same shape as `diverse`, no-download (tests / sanity).

Prints a JSON record of the run to stdout. The manifest persists to
the user's app data folder unless `--in-memory` is passed.

  source                -

                        ()
  -f [FILTER ...], --filter [FILTER ...]
                        ()
  --selector SELECTOR   ''
  -d DIAGNOSE_CLUSTERS, --diagnose-clusters DIAGNOSE_CLUSTERS
                        -1
  -i, --in-memory       False
